# Totem Protocol Binary Samples
# This file contains binary message samples for different Totem protocol versions
# Used by TotemProtocolDecoderTest and TotemFrameDecoderTest

# Totem Protocol Version 1 Samples
#############################################################

# Standard position update message (Version 1)
